subject.title: Add Tailscale Serve support for WSL gateways

question: Should OpenClaw core own this opt-in Tailscale Serve plus optional tailnet-identity authorization flow for generated WSL gateways after exact-head runtime proof is refreshed?
rationale: The patch adds new setup flags, UI, root-owned network provisioning, and an authorization mode; implementation correctness cannot decide whether that long-term core security/product surface is desired.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in core feature
options.body: Accept the bounded root-owned design after exact-head proof confirms the documented private Serve and authorization behavior.

options.title: Keep the gateway integration out of core
options.body: Decline the new setup and authentication surface and direct the capability toward an external integration if core ownership is not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in core feature
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded root-owned design after exact-head proof confirms the documented private Serve and authorization behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They integrated the current main conflict resolution and documented the security boundary retained by the final branch.
